ElIT Solutions · Three identity directions

Phase 1 exploration, three genuinely different routes. A Signal is the closest to the brief's taste, B Frame is the strongest umbrella system, C Edition is the creative wildcard. Nothing is final: pick a direction (or parts of several) to refine.

v0.1 · 16 Nov 2026
A · Recommended

Signal

Idea

Precise modules, one live signal. ElIT is spelled only with straight bars: E, l, I, T.

Symbol · 16 px · app icon
Palette

Midnight #0B1531 · Deep Space #070D20 · Ion Cyan #3DDCF4 · Aurora Violet #8B7BFF

Type · Moderustic Bold / Geologica
Digital solutions, engineered.

Websites, custom software and automation, engineered to last.

Pattern
In use
Personality

Precise, Nocturnal, Live, Confident

Strongest at

Most on-brief: modern, bold, premium, tech-native.

Main risk

Dark navy plus cyan is the most familiar territory of the three. Distinctiveness relies on the segmented E and on discipline (no gradients on the mark).

Umbrella scalability

Every product gets a bar-built initial (F for Flow, L for Ledger, H for Hub) with its own lit bar.

B

Frame

Idea

The frame every product is built in. ElIT is an umbrella: it builds things and will own products.

Symbol · 16 px · app icon
Palette

Concrete #F1F1EE · Graphite #17191F · Ember #FF5A1F · Steel #70737C

Type · Tektur SemiBold / Sofia Sans
Digital solutions, engineered.

Websites, custom software and automation, engineered to last.

Pattern
In use
Personality

Engineered, Direct, Solid, Warm-bold

Strongest at

Strongest umbrella logic: products live inside the frame, visibly ElIT-built.

Main risk

Corner brackets echo the "select / expand" UI glyph, so it needs the chamfer and core to stay ownable.

Umbrella scalability

Each product keeps the frame and changes its core: shape stays square, colour changes (Flow teal, Ledger violet, Hub amber).

C

Edition

Idea

Software, with an editor's hand. Every reference brand speaks in sans-serif and symbols.

Symbol · 16 px · app icon
Palette

Porcelain #F7F7F4 · Ink #0E1124 · Cobalt #1838C9 · Cobalt Light #6892FB

Type · Noto Serif Display Bold / Noto Sans
Digital solutions, engineered.

Websites, custom software and automation, engineered to last.

Pattern
In use
Personality

Assured, Editorial, Exact, Quietly bold

Strongest at

Most distinctive positioning: no symbol, no tech clichés, an uncommon serif for software.

Main risk

Weakest at small sizes: hairlines vanish and the 16 px favicon reads as a T. It needs a dedicated small mark in refinement.

Umbrella scalability

Products become editions: each product name is set in the serif under the cobalt overline, endorsed "by ElIT".

All three pass the brand-identity pipeline gates (contrast, English and Greek glyph coverage, OFL licences, 16/32 px logo renders). Mocks use sample copy and data.
